metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a BACK HUMP for Good (No Equipment!)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get rid of a back hump at home, using NO EQUIPMENT!

This video will be a very easy-to-follow three part guide that will focus on fixing a kyphosis (increased thoracic spine curve), also known as a hunchback or back hump. 

We'll focus on loosening stiffness and opening up the back, stretching out muscle tightness, and helping to strengthen the upper back -- which may help lessen an unsightly rounded upper back , but also may help prevent kyphosis it in the future. 

If you're looking to get the best results, make sure to go through all three parts.

Watch now and quickly fix a back hump at home! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:49 Self Release (Mobilization)
3:17 Seated Back Opener
4:59 Standing Back Opener
6:55 Bed Back Builder
9:45 Shoulder Blade Lift Off
